prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single objectively “best” agency — the best fit depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred working style.

To help you quickly find the right St. Louis digital marketing agency, tell me the answers to these (or I can start without them):
- Primary goal (lead generation, SEO, paid ads, brand, ecommerce growth, web design, etc.)
- Industry (B2B, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, SaaS, nonprofit, etc.)
- Monthly budget range
- Company size / monthly lead volume target
- Preference for strictly local in-person vs. remote-friendly

What I can do next
- Based on your answers I’ll shortlist 3–5 St. Louis agencies that match your needs, with strengths/weaknesses and examples to ask them for.
- Or I can show you how to evaluate agencies yourself and give an interview/RFP checklist.

Quick evaluation checklist (use this when comparing agencies)
- Proven case studies with measurable results (traffic, leads, cost per lead, ROI)
- Relevant industry experience and client references
- Clear scope, deliverables and reporting cadence (what KPIs they’ll track)
- Transparent pricing and contract terms (trial period, cancellation)
- Tools and processes (analytics, CRMs, creative production)
- Communication style and points of contact
- Team size / resources to support your account
- Cultural fit and responsiveness

Questions to ask agencies in your interviews
- Can you show 2–3 case studies like our business and KPIs you improved?
- Who will manage our account daily and can we meet them?
- What tools and reporting will we get and how often?
- What do you need from our team to get started?
- What are typical results/timeframes for our goals and budget?
- Can you provide references I can call?

Where to find and verify St. Louis agencies
- Clutch.co, UpCity, GoodFirms (reviews + case studies)
- Google Business reviews and LinkedIn company pages
- Local resources: St. Louis Business Journal, local networking groups, referrals from peers

If you want, give me your goals and budget and I’ll shortlist 3–5 St. Louis agencies and draft an email/RFP you can use to contact them. Which would you prefer?
